title: AiFallbackPolicyDocument
description: The no-deploy override for the try-it AI fallback (#2062) at aiFallbackPolicies/current: it can switch the fallback off and change the monthly cap and per-visitor daily reads within code bounds, never switch it on. Switching on is a code change in functions/src/commands/aiFallback/policy.ts that names the owner's decision and the published privacy-policy line. Written by staff through the Admin SDK only.
